commands:
mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
: > .prflow/tmp/displaced-paths.txt
git status --porcelain -z > .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before && git hash-object .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before
echo "snap-rc=$?"

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp; printf '' > .prflow/tmp/displaced-paths.txt; git status --porcelain -z > .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before; git hash-object .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before; echo "snap-rc=$?"
for f in regenerate-artifacts.py pin-corpus-lint.py; do echo "=== $f ==="; grep -nE "^(\+\+\+ b/lib/test/$f|diff --git.*$f)" .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1301/30963315916-1/diff.patch; done

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
# stale references to old docs/ paths (files that moved to docs/internal) in the LIVE tree.
# Exclude historical artifacts and the diff/tmp. Search for docs/<name> where name is a top-level internal doc.
grep -rnoE 'docs/(DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW|cloud-setup|cloud-allowlist|cloud-writer-boundary|implement-skill|install|efficiency-trace|workflow-triggers|working-directory-contract|shadow-review|review-agent-overrides|mintlify-publishing|execution-file-shape|creat …[per-command-truncated]

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
# Find, in the DIFF, any remaining '+' added line still using an old top-level docs path (should be none for moved files)
grep -nE '^\+' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1301/30963315916-1/diff.patch \
 | grep -oE 'docs/(cloud-setup|cloud-allowlist|implement-skill|install|efficiency-trace|workflow-triggers|DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW|shadow-review|execution-file-shape|cloud-writer-boundary|working-directory-contract|mintlify-publishing|review-agent-overrides|agents-seam-probe …[per-command-truncated]

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
